activity.notes: Representative military year 1288: Trần Hưng Đạo (Trần Quốc Tuấn) commanded the Đại Việt resistance to the Yuan invasion and played a central role in the Bạch Đằng naval victory, with Trần royal leadership including the retired emperor Trần Thánh Tông and emperor Trần Nhân Tông. This event point does not purport to cover his entire command or lifespan.
